cues: Its cells are living and thin walled, with conspicuous spaces between them.
It fills the cortex, pith, medullary rays and mesophyll.
It stores food and water, it is where most of the plant's metabolism happens, and it can still divide, which is why a cutting can regrow a whole plant.
